name: Open Trivia Database
summary: Free community-contributed trivia questions across 24 categories.
description: Returns multiple-choice or true/false questions filterable by category, difficulty and type, with optional session tokens to avoid repeats and a category question count endpoint.

rate_limit.summary: 1 request per 5 seconds per IP (response_code 5 when exceeded); max 50 questions/call

agent_notes: Request at most 50 questions per call and wait 5 seconds between calls (response_code 5 means rate limited). Add encode=url3986 or base64 to avoid HTML entities; use a session token to avoid repeats.
caveats: HTML entities in text unless encode set. Attribution required.
